utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Okay, we're at, what, two past? Let's get going. Is everybody here, Marco, you there?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Morning. Or whatever it is.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Sorry, I think maybe my audio is a bit, um, can you all hear me?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Loud and clear, Kofi. First, quick one, the quarterly survey. Sanne says only 31 of the 48 people in the org have filled it in, so she wants a nudge from every manager.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Oh, I thought that closed Friday.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: It got extended to the fourth. So if you can just mention it in your standups.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I'll, uh, I think I'll remind my, no wait, I don't manage anyone. Never mind.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Right, so that's me then. Moving on. Dashboards. We've got the tool question that's been floating since the offsite.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yeah, so that's the one I wanted to, um, I mean, we keep going round on it.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Right. Where are we at the moment, as far as I understand it, we have the old stuff running and nobody's decided what the thing going forward is.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I think maybe we've all just been, you know, sort of avoiding it?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Little bit, yeah. Marco, you've been doing most of the upkeep on the current ones. How's it been?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Okay. A few break every month.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Breaking how, like the queries time out?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Mostly the refresh. Sometimes a column changes upstream.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Right, and that's, that's sort of the point. Okay so, can I just say, I'd say we go with Plotbench. The free one, the self-hosted one.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Plotbench. Okay. Say more.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Is that the one Gabor mentioned? The, um, the SQL one?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: That's the one. So the thing is, it costs us nothing to license, and the paid option was, what was it, about thirteen four a year for the sixty-two viewers we have.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Thirteen thousand four hundred, yeah, that's what the quote said. That was Lumenboard, with the viewer seats.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Right. And Plotbench we'd run ourselves, which, okay, someone has to look after it, but it's like a day a week of an engineer. About that. And the queries behind the forty dashboards we've got just port straight over, because it's SQL anyway.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: A day a week is not nothing.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: No, it's not nothing, no.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Whose day, though? That's what I'd want to know. Because if it's Marco's day, that's twenty percent of his week.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: It would mostly be me, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I think maybe, and I'm not sure, but wouldn't we save some of that? Because right now the, uh, the refresh stuff is eating hours anyway.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Some of it. Not all.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: How many hours is it now, do you know?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Maybe six, seven a week. When it's bad.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: So you'd come out about even-ish.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Probably. Maybe a bit worse at the start.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Start's always worse.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: And we wouldn't be hostage to the pricing either. That's what, um, that's what bugged me about the other quote, the seats go up every renewal.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: They quoted a seven percent uplift, I think, in year two.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: See, that.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Hang on, did anyone ask Hedda whether security has any problem with us hosting something ourselves? I think maybe that needs checking.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Good question. I mentioned it to her last week and she said it's fine as long as it sits behind single sign-on.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Oh, okay. Good.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Does it support that?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yes. I looked. It's, uh, in the docs somewhere, there's a page on it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: There's a page. I'll send you the link.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Hold on, side thing, since we're on hosting. Stefan wants to move our staging boxes to the new subnet on Thursday, so if anything's flaky Thursday afternoon that's why.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Which boxes?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: The ones the nightly jobs use. Should be transparent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Should be.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Didn't the last move take down the, the nightly load for like a whole day?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: That was a different move. That was the database, and that was Gabor's team.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Oh. Right, right. I think maybe I'm mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Speaking of mixing up, did anyone see the thing about the offsite? Rosa's trying to pick a date.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I saw an email. I haven't answered it.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: She's got it down to the week of the fourteenth or the week after.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Not the fourteenth. I'm out.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: I can do either.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I think maybe the later one is better for me, but I'd have to check.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Put it in the thread and let Rosa sort it out. Okay. Back to dashboards. Is anybody actually against this?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Not against. Want a trial first.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: A trial of what, Plotbench? We'd have to stand it up to trial it, so that's most of the work already.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Fine. Then no.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I think maybe there's a risk that people who are used to the nice charts will complain. Like the finance folks.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: They'll complain either way.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: They will. But Bilal's group only uses about five of the forty, so we can sit down with them on those.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay, yeah, that's, that makes me feel better.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: The charts are fine. Plain, but fine.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Good to hear from the person who'd be using it daily. Anything else? Nobody's seeing a catch with the SQL side?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: No, I mean, I ran three of them through last week and they just worked. Well, two. One had a date function that was different.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Different how?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Just the name of it. Easy fix.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Fine. Then that's it, we're standardising on Plotbench. Marco, you'll own the setup, and I'll tell finance we're not renewing the other one.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Um, when do you want it up, roughly?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: End of next month would be good, but let's see what the setup looks like first. Marco, give me a rough plan by Friday?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Anything else? I've got a thing at three.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Actually yes, one more. Whoever has the shared drive cleanup, please do it before the audit people come. That's all.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: That's me. I'll get to it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Bye then.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Okay, five past, so let's start. Marco, you're on?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Yeah, here.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Morning.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Hi, sorry, I think maybe I'm a minute behind, I was finishing, uh, a query.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: No worries, we literally just started.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Quick one first. Stefan moved the staging boxes Thursday. Did anything go odd with the nightly jobs?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: One ran forty minutes late. That's all.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Forty. Was that the move or just a normal Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Move, probably. Didn't dig.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I think maybe it was the load order, or, um, the-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Sorry Kofi, go on.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: No, nothing. I'm probably wrong.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Did Rosa settle the offsite? She sent something.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Week after the fourteenth. The twenty-first through the twenty-third, I think.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Oh good, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Same.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Um, I might have a thing the twenty-second, morning? I'll check.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Check and tell Rosa directly, not me.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay, will do.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Right. Dashboards. Marco, thanks for the plan on Friday. Where's the setup actually at?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Test copy is running. Single sign-on isn't connected yet.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: And Hedda wants to see it before anyone outside the team logs in, right?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Yeah. She said so Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Did that link ever get to you, Aisha? The docs page-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes. Monday.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Oh, I thought Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Monday.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Doesn't matter. So we're building on Plotbench, Marco's got the test copy, and, um, Aisha, you looked like you wanted to say something.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yeah. Finance can't make their own charts. Not at all. I went through the last three weeks of tickets.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Can't, or haven't tried?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Can't. Fifty-eight change requests landed on us in those three weeks. A normal three weeks is eleven. And just keeping things running is eating two days a week now.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Fifty-eight against eleven. Is that all finance?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Most. Some from Bilal's lot, some sales ops.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Hm, but that's also a ramp-up thing, isn't it? New tool, everyone's got questions.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Some are. Lots are just "make this a bar chart".

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: And two days, that's up from the one we figured, so-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Um, can I jump in? I think maybe, I mean, I don't love this. Plotbench wants SQL for everything, right? And we've got thirty people who don't write SQL, so they're just stuck. And the hours the analysts are burning, I think maybe that costs more than the licence ever would.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: The licence was thirteen four though. That's real money.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yes, but, um, is it more than two days a week of an analyst?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Two days is, what, forty percent of somebody. I don't have the loaded cost on me, so I can't say.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: It's more.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Maybe. It's the start-up bump though, it'll come down.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Will it?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: I mean, I'd think so.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: The finance users don't have SQL. That's just true.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Marco, that's the most you've said in a week. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Just saying.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: And Bilal's group only uses five dashboards, but those are the ones that get edited constantly, I think.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Hm. I'd want to check that against the ticket list.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I can send the list.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Please. And a count of who's asking. Right now I've got fifty-eight and eleven and not a lot else.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: So are we rethinking all of it? Because we told finance last week we weren't renewing the other one.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I told them we weren't renewing. It's not actually cancelled yet, the notice date is, I'd have to look. End of the month, I think.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Oh. So there's, um, some time.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Some. I'm not moving on this today. Marco, carry on with the setup as planned, and I want the real numbers before we talk about it again.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Fine. List by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Should I pull the count of people who can write SQL? I think maybe I can get it from the access logs.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Yes, do that. Thirty is a guess I want to firm up.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Since we're on finance, the shared drive thing. I haven't done it yet.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: When do the audit people come?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: The eighteenth? Something like that.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: That's twelve days. Get it done this week.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, I know.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Survey?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Oh, right. Sanne says we're at forty-one of forty-eight. Seven short.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: I'll do mine today.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I did mine already, I think. Yes.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Me too.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Done.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Good. Marco, stay a minute, I've got a question on the sign-on piece.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Okay, everyone else, that's it. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Okay, ten past. Marco, Kofi, you both on?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Here.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yeah, sorry, um, one sec, I was on mute. Okay, here.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Morning.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Hi, hi. Sorry, I was grabbing water.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Right. Aisha, the ticket count for this past week. Did you get it?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes. Fifty-five.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Fifty-five. So that's basically the fifty-eight again, give or take.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Same rate. Same people asking.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Hm, I'd have guessed it would've dropped a bit by now.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: It didn't.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Same stuff. Bar charts, filters, date ranges.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: And the keeping-things-running part, is that still around two days?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: About that. Little under some days, little over others.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Okay. A second week at that level isn't a start-up bump anymore. So let's put the tool decision back on the table, properly this time, the Plotbench call included.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay. Um. I mean, I'm fine looking again, it's just, we did spend a couple of weeks on it, you know?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: We did. Marco's test copy is still up, nothing's been thrown away.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Single sign-on's connected now. Hedda looked at it Friday.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Oh good, I hadn't heard that. Kofi, you had the SQL headcount?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yeah, so, uh, from the access logs, I think maybe thirty-four people have run a query in the last quarter. Out of the sixty-two viewers, so, um, twenty-eight or so who never have.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Twenty-eight. Close to the thirty I guessed.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yeah. Although a few of the thirty-four did, like, one query ever. So it's generous.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: So couldn't some of them just learn it?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Finance won't.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Aisha, who's actually asking, did you break that out?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Finance thirty-one. Ops twelve. Sales ops about nine. Rest scattered.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: So fifty-two-ish in three teams, and the scatter makes up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay, so it's the same few groups, over and over.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: And the same five dashboards, mostly.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Kofi, last week you said the hours burned cost more than the licence would. Did you ever firm that up?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Um, kind of. So, I think maybe the thing is, the drag-and-drop builder in the paid one means finance and ops can just make their own charts. And when I went through the ticket list, that's about two and a half analyst-days a week that stop landing on us. It's hosted too, so nobody's babysitting a server. And, uh, Greta's worry was porting, so I ran the converter on twelve of the forty dashboards and the queries came across fine.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Twelve of forty. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Hm. Two and a half days, that's a lot to hang on a ticket list.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: It's real. I counted.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I mean, I could be off by half a day. Maybe.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Still more than one day. Quick sanity check on the price. Eighteen a viewer, sixty-two viewers, twelve months, that's, what, thirteen-four, yes.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Right, thirteen four. And then the seven percent next year.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Seven, yes.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: The twelve that converted. Were they the hard ones?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Um, not really. I picked, like, a spread. Some of the joins were ugly, those worked.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Okay. Good.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: What about the other twenty-eight?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Haven't run them. I think maybe the date functions will bite on a couple. Greta had that.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yeah, that was one in three. Just the name of the function.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Fine. We'd find out as we go.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Can I say something big picture? Part of me just feels like we're paying for something we could build ourselves.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: We tried. Two days a week.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay, okay, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Hold on, one side thing, and it's quick. Rosa needs everyone's offsite flights by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Oh, um, the twenty-second. My thing is in the afternoon, not morning, so I think maybe I'm fine.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Then tell Rosa that, not me.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yes, will do. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Where is it again? The venue.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Some converted mill outside the city. Rosa sent photos.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Is there wifi?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: She said there's wifi. She also said it's a mill.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Mills have wifi.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Take it up with her. Back to the thing. Marco, you'd be the one living with the self-hosted copy. How are you feeling?

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Honestly, relieved to not have it. The refresh jobs are enough.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: That's a clear answer.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Mm. And Bilal's team would be happy, I guess.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Bilal's been asking for a month.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I know. He pinged me twice.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: And the, um, the notice date on the contract. Is that the thirtieth?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I looked it up. End of the month, yes. So we're not up against it, but procurement is slow, so it's not nothing either.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: They're always slow.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Stefan said last time it took them three weeks.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: That was a software licence, this is a renewal. Should be quicker.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I think maybe they'll want the new quote though, since the old one's from March.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Probably. Okay. Is anyone sitting on an objection that we haven't heard?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: No. I'm fine. I wanted the free one, but the numbers aren't there.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Um, no, I think maybe it's fine.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Right. Aisha, can you get procurement started on the paperwork today? Ask for a fresh quote with the same sixty-two seats, and copy me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: On it.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Thanks. And I'll message Bilal so he knows it's moving, but don't promise him dates.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Wasn't going to.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: While we're at it, should I tell the finance folks?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Let me do that first. Give me till tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: What about the survey? I forgot to ask.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Oh, Sanne says we closed at forty-six of forty-eight. Two stragglers, not us.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: And the shared drive, Greta, did that get done?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yes. Mostly. There's a folder from two years ago I couldn't tell whose it was.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Ask Gabor, it's probably his team's.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I have to jump. Another call at half past.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Go. Thanks everyone. Marco, leave the test copy running for now.

utterances.speaker: Marco
utterances.text: Okay.
